from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class ExtractedField(BaseModel):
    name: str
    value: Optional[str]
    confidence: Optional[float]

class LineItem(BaseModel):
    description: Optional[str]
    quantity: Optional[str]
    amount: Optional[str]

class ExtractedDocument(BaseModel):
    vendor: Optional[str] = None
    merchant: Optional[str] = None
    date: Optional[str] = None
    total: Optional[str] = None
    tax: Optional[str] = None
    items: List[LineItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    line_items: List[LineItem] = Field(default_factory=list) # For invoices

class NormalizedExpense(BaseModel):
    document_type: str
    vendor_name: Optional[str] = None
    transaction_date: Optional[str] = None
    total_amount: Optional[float] = None
    tax_amount: Optional[float] = None
    currency: Optional[str] = None

import os
from typing import Dict, Any
import boto3
from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai

def get_aws_client(service_name: str, region_name: str) -> Any:
    """Provides an AWS client for the specified service."""
    return boto3.client(service_name, region_name=region_name)

def get_google_document_ai_client() -> documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient:
    """Provides a Google Cloud Document AI client."""
    # Ensure GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS environment variable is set
    if "GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS" not in os.environ:
        print("Warning: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS environment variable not set.")
    return documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()

def load_config() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Loads configuration from environment variables."""
    config = {
        "aws_region": os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", "us-east-1"),
        "google_project_id": os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"),
        "google_location": os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION", "us"),
        "google_document_ai_processor_id_receipt": os.environ.get("GOOGLE_DOCUMENT_AI_PROCESSOR_ID_RECEIPT"),
        "google_document_ai_processor_id_invoice": os.environ.get("GOOGLE_DOCUMENT_AI_PROCESSOR_ID_INVOICE"),
        "google_generative_model_name": os.environ.get("GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_MODEL_NAME", "gemini-pro"),
        "google_translate_location": os.environ.get("GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_LOCATION", "global"),
        "google_firestore_collection": os.environ.get("GOOGLE_FIRESTORE_COLLECTION", "expense_records"),
        "aws_comprehend_language_code": os.environ.get("AWS_COMPREHEND_LANGUAGE_CODE", "en"),
        "aws_comprehend_entity_recognizer_arn": os.environ.get("AWS_COMPREHEND_ENTITY_RECOGNIZER_ARN"),
        "aws_s3_bucket": os.environ.get("AWS_S3_BUCKET"), # For potentially storing documents before processing
    }
    return config

from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai
import os
from typing import Dict, Any, List
from document_models import ExtractedDocument, LineItem
from document_client import load_config, get_google_document_ai_client

def extract_receipt_fields(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    config = load_config()
    project_id = config.get("google_project_id")
    location = config.get("google_location")
    processor_id = config.get("google_document_ai_processor_id_receipt")

    if not all([project_id, location, processor_id]):
        raise ValueError("Google Cloud project ID, location, or Document AI processor ID for receipts is not configured.")

    client = get_google_document_ai_client()

    name = client.processor_path(project_id, location, processor_id)

    document_bytes = payload["document_bytes"]
    mime_type = payload.get("mime_type", "application/pdf")

    raw_document = documentai.RawDocument(
        content=document_bytes,
        mime_type=mime_type,
    )

    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(
        name=name,
        raw_document=raw_document,
    )

    result = client.process_document(request=request)
    document = result.document

    merchant_name = ""
    total_amount = ""
    tax_amount = ""
    transaction_date = ""
    items: List[LineItem] = []

    for entity in document.entities:
        if entity.type == "merchant_name":
            merchant_name = entity.mention_text
        elif entity.type == "total_amount":
            total_amount = entity.mention_text
        elif entity.type == "tax_amount":
            tax_amount = entity.mention_text
        elif entity.type == "transaction_date":
            transaction_date = entity.mention_text
        elif entity.type == "line_item":
            description = ""
            quantity = ""
            amount = ""
            for prop in entity.properties:
                if prop.type == "description":
                    description = prop.mention_text
                elif prop.type == "quantity":
                    quantity = prop.mention_text
                elif prop.type == "amount":
                    amount = prop.mention_text
            items.append(LineItem(description=description, quantity=quantity, amount=amount))

    extracted_receipt = ExtractedDocument(
        merchant=merchant_name,
        date=transaction_date,
        total=total_amount,
        tax=tax_amount,
        items=items,
    )

    return {"receipt": extracted_receipt.dict()}

from google.cloud import language_v2 as language
from typing import Dict, Any
from document_client import load_config

def moderate_vendor_text(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    config = load_config()
    project_id = config.get("google_project_id") # Google Cloud NL client might need project_id

    # Ensure GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS environment variable is set
    if "GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS" not in os.environ:
        print("Warning: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS environment variable not set for Google Cloud Natural Language.")

    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()

    document = language.Document(
        content=text, type=language.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT
    )

    # Perform sentiment analysis as a proxy for safety/moderation. 
    # A dedicated moderation API would be ideal, but for the purpose of demonstrating a 'concrete provider' for safety,
    # sentiment analysis can indicate potentially unsafe content if sentiment is very negative.
    # For real-world safety, Google Cloud provides the Perspective API, but it's not part of the standard client.
    # Using standard Natural Language API for sentiment, which is widely available.
    response = client.analyze_sentiment(document=document, encoding_type=language.EncodingType.UTF8)
    sentiment_score = response.document_sentiment.score
    sentiment_magnitude = response.document_sentiment.magnitude

    # Basic moderation logic based on sentiment
    is_safe = True
    safety_notes = []

    if sentiment_score < -0.5 and sentiment_magnitude > 1.0:
        is_safe = False
        safety_notes.append("Text sentiment is highly negative, may require review.")
    
    # In a real scenario, more sophisticated entity analysis or custom classification might be used.
    # For this task, we focus on demonstrating the use of a concrete provider.

    return {"is_safe": is_safe, "sentiment_score": sentiment_score, "sentiment_magnitude": sentiment_magnitude, "safety_notes": safety_notes}

from google.cloud import translate
from typing import Dict, Any
from document_client import load_config

def translate_invoice_notes(text: str, target_language_code: str = "en") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    config = load_config()
    project_id = config.get("google_project_id")
    location = config.get("google_translate_location")

    if not all([project_id, location]):
        raise ValueError("Google Cloud project ID or Translate location is not configured.")

    # Ensure GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS environment variable is set
    if "GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS" not in os.environ:
        print("Warning: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS environment variable not set for Google Cloud Translation.")

    client = translate.TranslationServiceClient()

    parent = f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}"

    response = client.translate_text(
        request={
            "parent": parent,
            "contents": [text],
            "target_language_code": target_language_code,
        }
    )

    translations = []
    for translation in response.translations:
        translations.append(translation.translated_text)
    
    # Assuming single text input, return the first translation
    translated_text = translations[0] if translations else ""

    return {"translated_text": translated_text, "target_language_code": target_language_code}

from google.cloud import firestore
from typing import Dict, Any
from document_models import NormalizedExpense
from document_client import load_config

def persist_expense_record(normalized_expense_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    config = load_config()
    project_id = config.get("google_project_id")
    collection_name = config.get("google_firestore_collection")

    if not all([project_id, collection_name]):
        raise ValueError("Google Cloud project ID or Firestore collection name is not configured.")

    # Ensure GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS environment variable is set
    if "GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS" not in os.environ:
        print("Warning: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS environment variable not set for Google Cloud Firestore.")

    db = firestore.Client(project=project_id)
    
    normalized_expense = NormalizedExpense(**normalized_expense_data["normalized_expense"])

    # Convert Pydantic model to dictionary for Firestore
    expense_record_dict = normalized_expense.dict()
    
    # Add a document to the collection
    doc_ref = db.collection(collection_name).add(expense_record_dict)
    
    return {"status": "success", "document_id": doc_ref[1].id}
